title: Sign in
subtitle: Use the email or outlet ID your dispatcher gave you.

pitch.title: Order for tomorrow, and know exactly when it arrives.
pitch.body: Place fresh, chilled and dry orders, follow the truck, and confirm what you received.

help.noAccount: No account? Your dispatcher creates store logins. Call your dispatcher to get one.
help.forgot: Forgot your password? Your dispatcher resets store logins. Call your dispatcher to reset it.

errors.format: Enter an outlet ID such as OUT015, or an email address.
errors.invalid: Wrong email, outlet ID or password.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Call your dispatcher.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
